data.title: AI-Generated Song Caleb Flynn Wrote for Mistress Played at Trial as She Hints at What the Lyrics Mean
data.description: Caleb Flynn allegedly used AI to write songs for his mistress, Alleigha Botner, that were played during his trial on Thursday, Sept. 24. Flynn is accused of killing his wife, Ashley Flynn, on Feb. 16. Botner reacted to the lyrics while in court on Thursday.
